issue.title: Enhancement: Add SPI controllers and devices for Nexthop platforms

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the enhancement

With https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/26133 , add drivers, SPI controllers and devices for Nexthop platforms to pddf-device.json

### Current Behavior

No SPI support in pddf-device.json

### Proposed Behavior

Nexthop platforms have PDDF support for SPI with the required drivers and kernel modules loaded. Nexthop platforms have SPI controllers and devices defined in pddf-device.json

resolution.title: Add PDDF SPI support for Nexthop platforms
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Add PDDF SPI support for Nexthop platforms

Resolves #27205

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**

#### How I did it

- Add kernel modules and drivers required for PDDF support to Nexthop platforms
- Define SPI controllers and associated SPI devices for Nexthop platforms in pddf-device.json

#### How to verify it

Install image. Create SPI device. Delete SPI device.

- [x] nexthop_4010
- [x] nexthop_4220
- [x] nexthop_5010

```
sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree SWITCHCARD_CONFIG_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree MEZZCARD_CONFIG_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH_D0
sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH_D1

ls /dev/mtd*

sudo mtd_debug info /dev/mtd0

sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree SWITCHCARD_CONFIG_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree MEZZCARD_CONFIG_FLASH
sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH_D0
sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree ASIC_BOOT_FLASH_D1
```
